description: Create a durable asynchronous cloud backfill job and return its canonical job_id with status queued promptly. Poll plugin::claude_code_cloud_session_source_plugin::backfill_status with job_id for stored status and terminal result/error. Credential, HTTPS and ledger walks run in a named worker. Busy means no request accepted: one cooperative local job spans both cloud plugins and all POSIX processes sharing canonical APP_HOME/data/cloud_backfill.lock. Normal requests skip existing sessions. After worker_interrupted or partial ingest, submit a fresh force=True request to refetch whole sessions; importer event upserts retain/deduplicate persisted effects. A fresh request is independent and may repeat HTTP: this is not atomic idempotent resume, automatic continuation or exactly-once remote work. No public resume or cancel verb. Separate hosts/APP_HOMEs and arbitrary core writers are outside the local exclusion guarantee.
embedding_description: Asynchronous cloud session backfill: durable queued job_id, backfill_status polling, cross-vendor local single-flight, worker_interrupted outcome and fresh force=True repair. Retains accepted requests and persisted events; interrupted work needs an explicit fresh forced retry, with no automatic replay or public cancellation.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Admission result: job_id, status queued, accepted true; or busy/stopping with accepted false and no job. Terminal result/error is read with backfill_status(job_id).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report accepted job_id and queued status, then poll backfill_status. Never report completion from admission. Stored processing is not evidence of a live worker. A 5-second lifecycle tick marks interrupted queued/processing jobs worker_interrupted when the shared lock is available, retaining request and ingest effects. For partial/interrupted work use a new force=True invocation.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Claude Code Cloud bearer-cell backfill walker invocation.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Admission filesystem/job persistence failures prevent safe durable acceptance. Worker failures, including auth and HTTP errors, are stored as terminal job errors. worker_interrupted retains request/history/effects; publication failure retains the request and is logged for later bounded reconciliation. An outcome_committed completion-delivery failure preserves the terminal outcome.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read backfill_status with the canonical job_id. For auth errors repair credentials interactively using the existing login procedure. After interruption or partial ingest explicitly submit backfill_from_cloud(force=True) as a new independent request; it can repeat HTTP and is not resume. Sequential requests have distinct job ids. Do not wait for automatic replay. Busy accepts nothing; retry a new invocation after the active worker settles.
